description: Computes the SHA-256 fingerprint of content in the standard Symbolon way, so that you and anyone checking later get exactly the same 64 hex characters. Give either `text` (fingerprint of its exact UTF-8 bytes: every space and line break counts) or `json` (fingerprint of its canonical form, RFC 8785 JCS; numbers must be integers, write amounts as strings like "12.50"). Keep the content exactly as given, and for JSON also the returned `canonical` text. Nothing is stored or sealed here. The content does pass through this door: for confidential content compute the fingerprint yourself (spec: https://github.com/symbolon-city/symbolon/blob/main/docs/FORMAT.md). Read-only.

json.description: A JSON value (object, array, string, integer, true/false/null); a string here is read as JSON text

text.description: Plain text, fingerprinted byte for byte

name: symbolon_fingerprint
title: Compute a fingerprint
